metadata.description: Configuration for free, open-source, single-player web games

ai_prompt.instruction: You are tasked with integrating single-player web games into a browser-based gaming platform. Each game entry contains the necessary information to embed and run the game. Use the implementation details to set up each game properly. All games are open-source, free to use, and designed to run directly in the browser without iframes where possible. Follow the setup instructions for each game carefully.
requirements: No iframe usage (use direct embedding when possible)
Games must be free and open-source

games.name: Doom
games.description: Classic first-person shooter compiled to WebAssembly

steps: Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/cloudflare/doom-wasm
Build the project or download pre-compiled WASM files
Include doom.wasm and doom.js in your web directory
Create an HTML page with canvas element: <canvas id='canvas'></canvas>
Load the doom.js script in your HTML
Initialize the game with Module.canvas = document.getElementById('canvas')
Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/gabrielecirulli/2048
Copy the js/, style/, and meta/ directories to your web root
Create an HTML file with the game container div
Link the CSS and JavaScript files
The game initializes automatically on page load
Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/dionyziz/canvas-tetris
Copy tetris.js to your web directory
Create an HTML file with a canvas element
Link the tetris.js script
Initialize the game with new Tetris()
Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/daleharvey/pacman
Copy all JavaScript files and sound files to your web directory
Include the main pacman.js file
Create a container div for the game
The game automatically initializes
Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/patorjk/JavaScript-Snake
Copy snake.js to your web directory
Create an HTML file with a canvas element
Link the script file
Game starts automatically

games.name: Minesweeper
games.description: Classic puzzle game about finding mines

steps: Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/wkud/minesweeper
Copy JavaScript and CSS files to your web directory
Create an HTML container for the game board
Link the CSS and JS files
Initialize with new Minesweeper()
Create a canvas element in HTML
Copy the breakout game JavaScript code
Initialize the game loop with requestAnimationFrame
Handle paddle controls with keyboard events

games.name: Chess
games.description: Classic chess game with AI opponent

steps: Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js
Include chess.js library
Add chessboard.js for the UI
Create a div for the chess board
Initialize with new Chess() and Chessboard()
Implement AI using minimax or similar algorithm
Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/dmcinnes/HTML5-Asteroids
Copy the JavaScript files to your web directory
Create a canvas element
Link the game scripts
Game initializes automatically

games.name: Sokoban
games.description: Classic puzzle game about pushing boxes

steps: Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/beginner-corp/sokoban
Copy game files to your web directory
Create a container div for the game
Link JavaScript and CSS files
Initialize the game with level data

hosting: All games can be hosted on static hosting platforms (GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel)
Ensure all game assets are properly licensed before deployment
Test games across different browsers for compatibility
optimization: Use CDN for common libraries when available
Implement lazy loading for better performance
common_dependencies: Most games require only vanilla JavaScript
Some games may need jQuery (can often be removed with refactoring)
Canvas API is supported in all modern browsers

integration_examples.game_selector: Create a menu page that lists all games and allows users to select which one to play
integration_examples.styling: Apply consistent CSS styling across all games for a unified look and feel
